privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: Kandy processes audio locally. Your voice never leaves your machine.
localPoints: Transcripts live in a local SQLite database.
Meeting recordings live as WAV files in the app data directory.
Whisper and VAD run on your GPU.
cloudPoints: Only transcribed text, and only when you request a summary.
The text is sent to the Kantega LLM proxy over HTTPS.
Kantega operates the LLM proxy itself.
The proxy uses only models hosted in Europe.
controlPoints: Delete individual meetings and transcripts from the history tab.
Delete the app data directory to reset everything.
Remove the LLM proxy key to disable summaries.
Delete the app to remove all traces from your machine.
privacy.noTelemetryBody: Kandy sends no usage stats, crash reports, or identifiers to Kantega or anyone else. No account, no login, no tracking.

appDataDirectory.description: Location where Kandy stores its data
